caption: The drawing depicts a small, rectangular, ornamented textile object, possibly a pouch, centered on a plain off-white background. The pouch is decorated with a diamond-shaped geometric pattern in multiple colors, including yellow, blue, turquoise, purple, pink, and red, with each diamond containing either floral or abstract motifs. The top flap of the pouch features a dark blue section with white or light letters and numbers reading "S. Ware 179". A curved button or clasp is depicted near the bottom center of the pouch in pale blue and gray tones. To the right of the pouch, there is a simple outlined square with measurements indicating the pouch's dimensions as 3 1/4 inches by 3 1/4 inches. Near the bottom right corner of the paper, there is a handwritten signature reading "Nellie Pyle fa."
title: Purse
